description: a predicts y after its restoration, and c's written route predicts y after the same synthetic T, through productions that can read. Both reach the one item of y over B. The item is shared, so the chosen a has one derivation, c fails for want of Z, and the check passes (engine §7.4).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%elidable T
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a A [T] y
%rule b A [T] [T] y
%rule c A [T y] Z
%rule y B
